summary: Added --otlp-service-name to SRT and diffusion server arguments, propagated it through every tracing process entry point, and implemented explicit CLI > OTEL_SERVICE_NAME > compatibility-default precedence. SRT retains the default service name 'sglang'; diffusion retains 'sglang-diffusion'. The resolved name is also forwarded to the asynchronous exporter process.

tests.what_was_measured: Pre-change reproduction: the recorded base hardcoded the SRT OTLP service name in all five process entry points named by the current architecture.

55 tests and 7 subtests passed, covering CLI parsing, explicit-name precedence, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME fallback, empty-value fallback, compatibility defaults, and propagation of the resolved name to the async exporter. Raw JUnit output is retained in focused-tests.xml.

A real OpenTelemetry SDK exporter sent a span to the repository's in-process OTLP gRPC collector; the exported Resource contained service.name=cli-name, proving CLI/configured precedence over the environment.
A real OpenTelemetry SDK exporter sent a span to the repository's in-process OTLP gRPC collector; the exported Resource contained service.name=env-name when no configured name was supplied.
All repository formatting, lint, spelling, syntax, and applicable policy hooks passed after the formatter's initial one-file rewrite.

gpu_execution.evidence: The feature only changes CLI/config propagation and OpenTelemetry Resource metadata. It has no GPU or numerical execution path; exercising a GPU would not add relevant evidence.

native_rebuilt.evidence: No C++, FlyDSL, compiler, or native-library source changed. A native rebuild is not applicable.

remaining_limitations: No model-backed HTTP server was launched because service.name is established before model execution and was validated directly through the real OTLP SDK/exporter/collector path.

Distributed multi-node and disaggregated model workloads were not launched; their process entry points were updated and the common tracing initializer plus async-exporter handoff were regression tested.
The qualified tiny Llama fixture was not used because it only adds transport and engine execution coverage, while this feature is fully observable at OTLP resource export without model weights.
